column1: The department uses low-flow, aerated shower heads. Water conservation is an issue in this part of the country.
column2: 警察局使用低流量的加氣淋浴頭。這一帶很重視節約用水。

column1: Giving it the white glove test? Aside from the moisture, you'll only get athlete's foot germs on your hand.
column2: 要用白手套測試嗎？除了水氣以外，你只會在手上沾到香港腳的細菌。

column1: The showers remind you of your high school gym days, where the same rules applied: don't bump into anybody, don't make eye contact, and never let 'em catch you looking below eye level.
column2: 淋浴間讓你想起高中體育館的日子；規則一樣：別撞到任何人、別和人眼神交會，也絕不能讓人發現你往腰部以下看。

column1: You know the "Whitey" disguise is pretty lame but you've got to change into it before you can go undercover.
column2: 你知道「Whitey」偽裝很蹩腳，但臥底前必須換上它。

column1: You'd better change into your uniform. You're late as it is.
column2: 你最好換上制服。你已經遲到了。

column1: You don't need that uniform when you're off duty.
column2: 下班時不需要穿那套制服。

column1: When you're on duty, you must wear a regulation uniform.
column2: 值勤時必須穿規定制服。

column1: You're a Narc detective now. You don't need that trusty blue anymore.
column2: 你現在是緝毒探員，不再需要那套可靠的藍制服。

column1: Only uniformed officers are allowed to carry that.
column2: 只有穿制服的警員可以攜帶那件物品。

column1: You should think about removing your clothes first before taking a shower. You'll get cleaner that way.
column2: 洗澡前應該先脫衣服。那樣才能洗得更乾淨。

column1: You've already taken a shower.
column2: 你已經洗過澡了。

column1: Hey, Sonny! What do you think, will Morris scrub away to nothing or will he get waterlogged and become the first living drain plug? Ha ha!
column2: 嘿，Sonny！你覺得 Morris 會洗到消失，還是會泡到變成第一個活水塞？哈哈！

column1: You're undercover now. Taking that with you might blow your cover.
column2: 你現在正在臥底。帶著那件東西可能會暴露身分。

column1: That must be the wrong combination. Now what WAS that Grunters-Sows score again? Better check your copy of the Gazette.
column2: 密碼一定錯了。Grunters 對 Sows 的比分究竟是多少？最好查查你的公報。

column1: You took care of that before you left the house this morning.
column2: 你今天早上離家前已經處理過了。

column1: Those are toilet stalls. You hate using them, so you're careful to use the facilities at home before coming to work.
column2: 那些是廁所隔間。你討厭使用它們，所以每天上班前都會先在家解決。

column1: You change into the disguise. Oh, God, it's a leisure suit!
column2: 你換上偽裝。天啊，是休閒服！

column1: You also find a wallet containing the undercover money you'll need.
column2: 你還找到一個皮夾，裡面有臥底時需要的錢。

column1: Bleach your hair first, so you don't end up ruining the - yecch! - leisure suit.
column2: 先漂白頭髮，免得最後弄壞那件——呸！——休閒服。

column1: You hang up your "hustler" suit. You're glad to be rid of it!
column2: 你掛起「花花公子」套裝。擺脫它真令人高興！

column1: That outfit wouldn't be in good taste at this time.
column2: 現在穿那套衣服不太合適。

column1: It's your horrid 'Whitey' disguise.
column2: 這是你可怕的「Whitey」偽裝。

column1: Everything in the room is covered with dampness from the showers. It's unpleasant to touch.
column2: 房間裡的一切都被淋浴的水氣覆蓋，摸起來很不舒服。

column1: It's the steamy, sweaty locker room for the male cops.
column2: 這是悶熱、滿是汗味的男警員更衣室。

column1: You get the towel and put it on. You were raised to be modest!
column2: 你拿起毛巾披上。你從小就被教導要端莊！

column1: You place the towel back in the locker, and hope it doesn't grow mildew. Yuk!
column2: 你把毛巾放回置物櫃，希望它不會發霉。噁！

column1: You already took a shower. How clean do you want to get?
column2: 你已經洗過澡了。你還想洗得多乾淨？

column1: It's your towel. You may want to think about taking it home and washing it someday.
column2: 這是你的毛巾。也許哪天該帶回家洗一洗。

column1: You change into your trusty blue uniform.
column2: 你換上可靠的藍制服。

column1: You don't need to wear that uniform anymore. You're a Narc officer now.
column2: 你不再需要穿那套制服。你現在是緝毒警員。

column1: Regulations state you must take a shower before changing into your uniform.
column2: 規定要求你換制服前必須先洗澡。

column1: You carefully hang up your uniform. Those cleaning bills are a wallet drainer, and they're non-deductible.
column2: 你小心掛起制服。清洗費會掏空皮夾，而且不能抵稅。

column1: You don't need to wear your uniform now.
column2: 你現在不需要穿制服。

column1: It's your trusty blue uniform and patrol belt.
column2: 這是你可靠的藍制服和巡邏腰帶。

column1: There's nothing worth taking here.
column2: 這裡沒有值得拿走的東西。

column1: This is your briefing spot.
column2: 這是你的簡報位置。

column1: Whatever you had in mind, it's too late, Bonds; the briefing will start shortly.
column2: 不管你原本想做什麼，都太晚了，Bonds；簡報很快就要開始。

column1: The door leads back out to the main hall.
column2: 這扇門通往主走廊。

column1: Sit down, Officer Bonds. You're not giving the briefing.
column2: 坐下，Bonds 警官。不是你主持簡報。

column1: The chalkboard is used during briefings.
column2: 簡報時會使用黑板。

column1: Better pay attention, pal.
column2: 最好專心一點，老兄。

column1: Hi, guy.
column2: 嗨，夥計。

column1: Wow, these double shifts are tough!
column2: 哇，連續兩班真累人！

column1: The lectern is used for briefings.
column2: 簡報時會使用講台。
